title: Cave Copter
description: Fly your chopper through a never-ending cave. How far can you get?
instructions: Hold the left mouse button or SPACE to climb, release to drop. Avoid the walls and the blocks.

title: Serpent Sprint
description: The classic snake game. Eat the apples, grow longer and don't bite your own tail!
instructions: Use the ARROW keys or WASD to steer the snake. On touch screens, swipe.

title: Brick Buster
description: Smash every brick with your bat and ball. Grab the power-ups as they fall!
instructions: Move the mouse or use the LEFT and RIGHT arrow keys to move the bat. Click or press SPACE to launch the ball.

title: Space Rocks
description: Pilot your ship through a deadly asteroid field and blast the rocks to dust.
instructions: LEFT / RIGHT to rotate, UP to thrust, SPACE to fire.

title: Alien Assault
description: Wave after wave of aliens are marching on Earth. Only your laser cannon can stop them!
instructions: LEFT / RIGHT arrow keys to move, SPACE to fire. Hide behind the bunkers.

title: City Defender
description: Missiles are raining down on your cities. Shoot them out of the sky before it's too late!
instructions: Click anywhere to fire an interceptor. The explosion destroys any missile it touches.

title: Tank Duel
description: Two tanks, one hill. Set your angle and power and blow your opponent off the map!
instructions: LEFT / RIGHT to aim, UP / DOWN to change power, SPACE to fire. Play against the computer or a friend on the same keyboard.

title: Block Drop
description: Rotate and drop the falling blocks to complete lines. A timeless puzzle classic.
instructions: LEFT / RIGHT to move, UP to rotate, DOWN to drop faster, SPACE for a hard drop.

title: Number Merge
description: Slide the tiles and merge matching numbers. Can you reach 2048?
instructions: Use the ARROW keys (or swipe) to slide every tile. Two tiles with the same number merge into one.

title: Mine Sweep
description: Clear the minefield without setting off a single mine. Use the numbers to work out where they are hidden.
instructions: Left click to uncover a square. Right click (or hold on touch screens) to place a flag.

title: Box Pusher
description: Push every crate onto its target in this warehouse puzzler. 10 tricky levels!
instructions: ARROW keys to move. You can only push boxes, not pull them. Press R to restart a level, U to undo.

title: Lights Out
description: Click a light to switch it and its neighbours. Turn every light off to win!
instructions: Click a square to toggle it and the four squares next to it. Switch off all the lights in as few moves as possible.

title: Sudoku Daily
description: A brand new Sudoku puzzle every single day. Fill the grid so every row, column and box contains 1 to 9.
instructions: Click a square, then type a number (or click the number buttons). Press N to toggle pencil notes.

title: Mahjong Daily
description: Match pairs of free tiles to clear the board. A new tile layout is dealt every day.
instructions: Click two matching tiles to remove them. A tile is free when nothing is on top of it and its left or right side is open.

title: Jewel Swap
description: Swap neighbouring jewels to make rows of three or more. Chain reactions score big!
instructions: Click a jewel, then click a jewel next to it to swap them. Only swaps that make a match are allowed.

title: Memory Match
description: Flip the cards and find the matching pairs. How good is your memory?
instructions: Click two cards to turn them over. If they match they stay face up. Find all the pairs in as few turns as possible.

title: Mole Mayhem
description: The moles are taking over the garden! Whack as many as you can in 60 seconds.
instructions: Click the moles as they pop out of their holes. Don't hit the bunnies!

title: Color Echo
description: Watch the lights, listen to the tones and repeat the pattern. It gets longer every round!
instructions: Watch the sequence, then click the coloured pads in the same order. Keys 1-4 work too.

title: Bubble Wrap
description: The most relaxing game on the internet. Pop! Pop! Pop!
instructions: Click (or drag over) the bubbles to pop them. When the sheet is finished, a new one appears.

title: Paddle Pong
description: The original video game sport. Beat the computer or challenge a friend on the same keyboard.
instructions: Player 1: W / S keys (or the mouse). Player 2: UP / DOWN arrow keys. First to 7 points wins.

title: Hoop Shot
description: Drag, aim and shoot! Sink as many baskets as you can before the buzzer.
instructions: Click and drag back from the ball to aim, then let go to shoot. Swishes score double.

title: Mini Putt
description: Nine holes of crazy golf. Bank your shots off the walls and aim for a hole in one!
instructions: Click and drag away from the ball to set the direction and power, then release to putt.

title: Penalty Kick
description: It all comes down to penalties! Pick your spot and beat the goalkeeper.
instructions: Click inside the goal to aim your shot. The closer to the corners, the harder it is to save - and to hit!

title: Air Hockey
description: Fast and furious table hockey. Play the computer or a friend on the same computer.
instructions: Player 1 uses the mouse. Player 2 uses the ARROW keys. First to 7 goals wins.

title: Turbo Track
description: Top-down racing on three twisty circuits. Race the clock or a friend on the same keyboard.
instructions: Player 1: ARROW keys. Player 2: W A S D. Complete 3 laps as fast as you can.

title: Highway Dash
description: Weave through the traffic at top speed. One crash and it's game over!
instructions: LEFT / RIGHT arrow keys (or the mouse) to change lanes. Collect the fuel cans.

title: Moto Hill
description: Ride your dirt bike over bumps, jumps and ramps. Keep it balanced or you'll wipe out!
instructions: UP to accelerate, DOWN to brake, LEFT / RIGHT to lean the rider. Reach the flag without crashing.

title: Ski Slalom
description: Race down the mountain and pass through the gates. Watch out for trees!
instructions: LEFT / RIGHT arrow keys (or move the mouse) to steer. Go through every pair of flags. Missed gates cost time.

title: Light Cycles
description: Ride your light cycle and trap your opponent behind your glowing trail. One or two players.
instructions: Player 1: W A S D. Player 2: ARROW keys. Don't hit any walls or trails.

title: Castle Guard
description: Build towers along the path and stop the goblin army from reaching your castle.
instructions: Click a tower button, then click on the grass to build it. Towers fire automatically. Survive all 15 waves!

title: Four in a Row
description: Drop your counters and be the first to get four in a row. Play the computer or a friend.
instructions: Click a column to drop a counter. Get four of your colour in a line - across, down or diagonally.

title: Tic Tac Toe
description: Noughts and crosses. Can you beat the computer on hard?
instructions: Click a square to place your mark. Get three in a row to win. Choose 1 player or 2 players on the title screen.

title: Reversi
description: Outflank your opponent's discs to flip them to your colour. Easy to learn, hard to master.
instructions: Click a square to place a disc. You must trap at least one of your opponent's discs between yours.

title: Pixel Runner
description: Run, jump and double jump across the rooftops. How far can you run?
instructions: Press SPACE, UP or click to jump. Press again in mid-air to double jump.

title: Jumpin' Jack
description: Help Jack collect all the coins and reach the exit door in 8 platform levels.
instructions: LEFT / RIGHT arrow keys to run, UP or SPACE to jump. Stomp on the slimes, avoid the spikes.

title: Dungeon Dash
description: Explore a randomly generated dungeon, fight monsters, find treasure and go deeper and deeper.
instructions: ARROW keys or WASD to move. Walk into monsters to attack them. Find the stairs to go down a level.

title: Treasure Diver
description: Dive to the bottom of the sea in your mini sub. Grab the gold, but keep an eye on your air!
instructions: ARROW keys to steer the submarine. Collect treasure and air bubbles. Return to the surface to bank your gold.

title: Maze Muncher
description: Munch all the dots in the maze while escaping the ghosts. Eat a power pill to turn the tables!
instructions: ARROW keys or WASD to move through the maze.

title: Road Hopper
description: Help the frog cross the busy road and the river to get home safely.
instructions: ARROW keys to hop. Ride the logs across the river - don't fall in the water!

title: Tower Stack
description: Drop the sliding blocks to build the tallest tower you can. Perfect drops keep it wide!
instructions: Click or press SPACE to drop the moving block. Any part hanging over the edge gets chopped off.

title: Type Attack
description: Words are falling from the sky! Type them before they hit the ground. Great typing practice.
instructions: Type the falling words and press ENTER (or just finish the word) to destroy them.

title: Critter Cannon
description: Launch the critter out of the cannon and bounce it as far as you can. Boing!
instructions: Move the mouse to aim, hold the mouse button to charge the power and release to fire. Bounce pads help, spikes don't!

title: Flash Bounce
description: A tiny animated Flash movie, played by the Ruffle Flash emulator. Use it to check Flash support works!
instructions: Just sit back and watch. This .swf file was created from scratch for this site and is played by Ruffle.

title: Sketch Pad
description: Draw, doodle and paint with brushes, stamps and a paint bucket. Save your masterpiece as a picture.
instructions: Pick a tool and a colour, then draw on the canvas with the mouse. Use Save to download your picture.
